d
When
ara::per::KeyValueStorage::SyncToStorage
is
called,
Persistency
shall store all changes permanently that have been done to
the
Key-Value Storage
since the last call to this method or since the
Key-Value
Storage
was opened.
Persistency
shall also update any configured
redundancy
within this call.
